{{recipesummary|category=Side dish recipes|servings=varies|time=15 minutes|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Side dishes|Side dishes]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United Kingdom|British cuisine]]

'''Bubble and squeak''' is a traditional English vegetable dish made from the leftover vegetables from a Sunday roast. The name is derived from the sound the dish makes while cooking.

==Ingredients==
*1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]] (optional), [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Oil and fat|fat or oil]]
*Various cooked [[Cookbook:Vegetable|vegetable]]s (e.g. [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]], [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], [[Cookbook:Pea|peas]], and/or [[Cookbook:Brussels Sprout|Brussels sprouts]])

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] the chopped [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]] in fat or oil.
#Chop the vegetables, and add to the pan.
#Cook over a medium heat till the underside is golden brown and crispy, then turn it, scraping the crispy bits into the mix. Repeat the turning and scraping a few times until browned and cooked through.
